status: research design recorded after examining expanded historical and partial-2026 results; not an external preregistration
open: amendment-aware calendar dates for every used training/test event
second independently developed covariate-capable foundation model
richer local baselines and refit-frequency comparisons
proposed_primary_question: Does documented regional calendar provenance improve event-balanced forecast accuracy relative to a generic calendar when event encoding and feature count are controlled?
proposed_primary_contrast: documented regional versus generic date ledger; identical scalar encoding, matched targets and fixed model; final operationalisation depends on ledger audit
proposed_primary_metric: mean within-event/year/state MAE divided by prior-year training weekly-difference scale, aggregated with explicit equal event-year weighting

negative_control_plan.placebo: weekday/season matched non-event dates, chosen independent of target values

development: all already examined 2022-2026 observations remain development/exploratory for new methods
confirmation: new data/source with model-specific temporal exposure checks; model versions, exact dates and selection rules must be frozen before new outcomes are viewed; no present result called confirmatory
prospective_festival: 2026 Diwali absent from current snapshot; no prospective forecasts made in this checkpoint
stop_rules: no claimed encoding mechanism if placebo/equal-dimensional controls explain the effect
no new-method claim without distinct literature contribution and unseen-event/region evidence
no public dataset release until reuse rights resolved
mutability: This is a draft next-study design. Final choices and changes must be versioned before confirmation; do not retroactively call it preregistered.
